PC: Initial work up should include IV, cardiac monitor, labs sent off, and an EKG.
Cardioversion at correct voltage and synchronized
Ensure adequate sedation with drug that does not cause hypotension.
ICS: Staff members should be focused on not only the initial history, but acknowledging the son’s concerns, explaining the process, and assuring him that cardiology will be involved but the ED staff must initiate her care.
Staff should also focus on non-verbal communication skills.
The EKG returns first showing normal sinus without ischemia, and this should be explained to the son.
Informing patient and family of the plan
Call-outs and check backs when orders are ordered and performed
Situational Awareness by all members of staff- recognition of changing patient interaction.
Decision Making- Leaders guide care but other members of team are involved.
